name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.195.0 — Two drivers that used to no-op silently now refuse with a remedy. A mocks seed.md declaring no journeys left the SCREENS derivation iterating an empty set, so a mock could walk to APPROVED with no screen ever drawn; `--mark seed-done` now refuses that seed naming the `### <journey>` grammar to add. And the genesis driver's derived mock-app picks (framework, language, package-manager) were dropped without a word when brief.md carried no `## Picks` heading, leaving those dimensions recorded as neither open nor decided; MENUS now dies naming the missing heading and the picks that had nowhere to land. 7.194.0 — Corrects two stale prose claims: the sketch command no longer says the session ratifies a surface approval (only the approval made on the mock page advances it), and the roadmap-overview template no longer claims the mock viewer composes the journey graph from roadmap surfaces blocks (SEED parses those blocks into the mock app journeys.ts). 7.193.0 — Git-ignored path derivation is now one shared library (spec/scripts/lib/ignored-paths.js) used by both repo walks — scope-reconcile's at-risk walk and red-check's wildcard tests-row expansion — so a wildcard File Plan row no longer resolves test files inside git-ignored checkouts; an exact-path row is still resolved wherever it points, and a wildcard that expands to zero files now raises a warning instead of passing in silence.
